LIKELIHOOD: Cannot reliably assign a number from these facts.

An all-male panel is worth questioning as a procedural concern, but it does not establish that sex influenced the decision. Your PhD and eight years leading a section are strong credentials; they do not automatically outweigh relevant leadership experience or other published criteria.

Follow up now on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment against them, and the applicable panel-composition policy. Raise the panel’s composition neutrally rather than alleging discrimination.

If explanations reveal inconsistent criteria, sex-based assumptions, or departures from policy, seek advice from your union or an equality adviser. Check local complaint deadlines promptly; awaiting a response may not pause them.
